description: This file contains initialization code for the Silicon Labs EFM32/EFX32 series System on Chip (SoC), including clock setup, oscillator configuration, power management, and debug interface setup, specifically for the EXX32 variant within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: init_lfxo
methods.description: Initializes the Low Frequency External Oscillator (LFXO) if not used as a system clock source.

methods.name: clock_init
methods.description: Configures the system clock source and peripheral clocks based on compile-time configuration.

methods.name: dcdc_init
methods.description: Initializes the on-chip DC-DC converter in various modes depending on configuration.

methods.name: swo_init
methods.description: Sets up the Serial Wire Output (SWO) debug interface pin and clock for debugging.

methods.name: silabs_exx32_init
methods.description: Performs overall hardware initialization, including chip errata handling, oscillator setup, power management, and debug interface configuration.
